## 6. The decisive unresolved operation: retain physical correlations

The independent-edge core is now mathematically supplied. The full destination requires the joint posterior generated by local circuit faults.

Here is an exact reason that extending the matching construction is substantive.

Represent one depolarizing fault by four detector ports: \(a,b\) for its \(X\)-component and \(c,d\) for its \(Z\)-component. The local probability signature is
\[
F(\varnothing)=1-p,\qquad
F(ab)=F(cd)=F(abcd)=p/3,
\]
with the other two-port patterns forbidden.

Every nonnegative perfect-matching gadget, with any number of hidden vertices, satisfies
\[
F(\varnothing)F(abcd)
\le
F(ab)F(cd)+F(ac)F(bd)+F(ad)F(bc).
\tag{17}
\]
This follows from the alternating-path exchange inequality in Liu–Meng, Lemma 4.1. :chatgpt-content-reference{index="5"}

For the physical signature, (17) requires
\[
\frac{p(1-p)}3\le\frac{p^2}{9},
\]
which fails for every \(0<p<3/4\). The violation is
\[
\frac{p(3-4p)}9>0.
\]

**Consequently, ordinary low-noise \(X/Z\) correlation cannot be absorbed by replacing each fault location with a larger positive matching gadget.** Positive port rescaling cannot repair the inequality. This is a local representation obstruction, not a hardness theorem for correlated decoding.

There is also a substantial computational-cost gap: the published matching proof contains a comparison constant proportional to \((10N)^{80}r^9\). Polynomial existence does not establish useful decoder latency. :chatgpt-content-reference{index="6"}

The next decisive operation is therefore:

> **Compute the joint logical-class weights of coupled spacetime error ensembles while retaining their actual local Pauli factors, with controlled relative error and usable cost.**

A different global representation or a rigorously controlled treatment of correlations must provide that operation. The positive construction above supplies a complete reference case, an acquired-rate interface and the exact reliability standard the extension must preserve. The four-port obstruction identifies a tempting route that cannot close it. Until the correlated operation and its computational cost are earned, I would treat this as a substantive opening toward scalable quantum fault tolerance—not the completed civilisation-level capability.
